title: festuca rupicola var. coziae
intro: Festuca rupicola var. coziae, commonly known as Cozia's fescue, is a rare and endemic species of grass native to Romania. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cozia's fescue include wound healing, antimicrobial protection, and potential anticancer effects, primarily due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and saponins. The exact bioactive constituents responsible for these effects are still being researched and identified, but its potential as a natural remedy has garnered interest in the scientific community.
